assets.prompt: One square transparent PNG sprite atlas for a first-grade community greenhouse picture book. EXACT 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, SIX single isolated sprites, centers at x about 17%, 50%, 83%, y about 25%, 75%, with broad truly transparent gutters at least 8% of width and each wholly within its own cell. Top row left to right: a tiny sprout growing from one terracotta flowerpot, one sealed mint-green seed paper packet with a small plain leaf emblem, one vertical ochre garden plant marker with no inscription. Bottom row left to right: one squat green plastic starter tray with a blank top, one friendly low terracotta-and-pine wooden garden trolley in perfectly horizontal side profile at rest, the same trolley in a gently tilted moving three-quarter pose. Make sprites generously scaled but fully separated. Matte gouache, tiny subtle paper grain, layered cut-paper silhouettes, cream/apricot/pine green. No letters, digits, outlines of cells, pictorial background, gradient, floating decorations, or cast shadows beyond each object's own silhouette.
